Quick note to align on PO timing and what we need to hit July bookings recognition for your Q3 contract. Finance has a hard cutoff for PO arrival and signed SOW/PO acceptance to include in July revenue close. High level: 

- Cutoff for July recognition: PO and signed paperwork received in our AP system by end-of-day PDT on 2028-06-28.
- If PO arrives after the cutoff, recognition will move to the next monthly close (August).
- We can accept a partial PO for the first tranche if you need phased billing, but please flag it so Rishi can confirm recognition percentages.

Samantha — looping in finance to clarify the rules and options so planning is clean on both sides. TL;DR: draft PO is helpful for the forecast but does not satisfy GAAP/recognition rules unless we have signed commitment or an exception that meets our revenue recognition evidence requirements. Details below: 

- Recognition rules: We require a signed PO or signed SOW and either an invoice or delivery evidence (depending on contract type) before the close date to include in that month.
- Draft PO: can be held as 'probable' in the sales forecast but not recognized as revenue until signed. We can grant a one-off operational exception in rare cases (requires approval from Finance Director) if the customer provides an irrevocable purchase commitment (e.g., signed authorization email from a delegated approver AND PO number).
- Milestone invoices: If the contract is milestone-based and a milestone is completed prior to cutoff, we can recognize the proportionate revenue associated with that milestone provided there is clear acceptance evidence (email sign-off or ticket closure) and an approved PO referencing the milestone schedule.

Next steps I recommend: 
- Samantha/procurement: share the draft PO and expected sign-off date (if you can target 06/27 we can plan to include it in July close).
- Ava/Ben: prepare a one-paragraph acceptance evidence template that Acme can use to accelerate milestone acceptance (example language attached).
- I'll open a short exception ticket if Acme's procurement believes they can supply an approver email + PO number by 06/28.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/47592 (ACME-2028-Q3)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/12345AB (SOW awaiting signature)

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
